_doc: Measured gate scorecard schema v2. Events are source records; all precision, coverage, validation, and status fields are computed by harness.gate_scorecard.
adjudicator_independence_sentence: adjudicator_independence is the share of adjudications made by an external_auditor; today it is expected to be 0 because no external-auditor adjudication is recorded
auditor_correction: If the same environment labels its own gate outputs true or false, that is: system produces output -> system labels its own output correct -> agreement read as validation (the 6/6 recall shape). So every refusal is an EVENT with an ADJUDICATION OBJECT, and a gate's numbers are computed only from those objects.
